datasheet_identity.title: MMSZ4678 THRU MMSZ4717 SURFACE MOUNT ZENER DIODES

extraction_notes: The only plotted figures are power dissipation versus ambient temperature and transient thermal impedance versus pulse duration; neither is an electrical diode curve usable for extraction.
MMSZ4688 zener voltage is specified as minimum 4.47 V, nominal 4.7 V, maximum 4.94 V at IZT = 50 uA. The breakdown-voltage field records the nominal value and preserves the min/max bin in this note.
The datasheet's electrical-parameter legend defines ZZT and ZZK, but the MMSZ4688 table provides no zener-impedance values, so knee sharpness cannot be extracted.
Maximum ratings include PD = 500 mW, Tstg = -55 to +150 degC, and Tj = -55 to +150 degC at Ta = 25 degC unless otherwise specified.
No capacitance or reverse-recovery data are published.
omission_reason: No usable electrical diode curve is present. The datasheet contains only thermal derating and transient thermal impedance plots; the zener electrical data are tabulated without an I-V or impedance curve.
